references.text: Describes the neighborhood and neighbors who recognize the healed man as the same person who was previously blind, before he is taken to the Pharisees.
Continues the account of the healed man being brought to the Pharisees and describes their immediate reaction and debate about Jesus.
The Pharisees summon the parents of the man who had been blind to confirm his identity, a direct follow-up to him being brought to them in verse 13.
The Pharisees call the healed man in for a second time to demand a confession, after having first examined him in verse 13.
